## Your agent becomes your infra engineer

Spawned is built on a cutting-edge declarative framework, that allows agents to build in your cloud, while you know exactly what you have. Never have to worry about galloping cloud bills, misconfigurations, or hallucinated components that gets forgotten.

## Everything in one place

Deployments, environments, logs, and policy controls in one operational surface, instead of navigating complex cloud consoles. Resources are grouped by project and fully versioned, so you always know exactly what you have.

## Don't have a Cloud account? Use ours!

On selected clouds we offer managed versions for you to host on. Some capabilities are limited, to keep the shared cloud safe, but this is the easiest way to try out Spawned, while also getting the benefits of uptime and scaling of the hyperscaler clouds.
